title: Offbeat Japan Hiroshima Route
alt: Floating torii gate at Miyajima island near Hiroshima
transport: Bullet trains, a ferry to Miyajima and guided day tours

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Fifteen days with three nights in Hiroshima, which almost no itinerary gives you. It changes the trip.
expert.tip: Keep the free Hiroshima day for Shukkeien garden in the morning and okonomiyaki in the station lanes at night.

summary: Fifteen unhurried days through four cities: four nights in Shinjuku with a city tour and Mount Fuji, three in Hiroshima for the peace park and Miyajima island, three in Kyoto with a Kyoto and Nara day, then four in Osaka with a walking tour and Universal Studios Japan.
included: Included: 14 nights with daily breakfast; bullet trains between the cities; private airport transfers; a full day of guided sightseeing in Tokyo with lunch; the Mount Fuji fifth station and Lake Ashi, returning by bullet train; a guided day through the Hiroshima peace park with the ferry to Miyajima; a guided day through Kyoto and Nara with a buffet lunch; a guided walk through central Osaka; admission to Universal Studios Japan.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
